text: Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita
translation: In the middle of the path of our life

text: mi ritrovai per una selva oscura,
translation: I found myself again through a dark forest,

text: ché la diritta via era smarrita.
translation: for the straight way was lost.

text: Ahi quanto a dir qual era è cosa dura
translation: Ah how hard a thing it is to say what it was,

text: esta selva selvaggia e aspra e forte
translation: this forest savage and harsh and strong

text: che nel pensier rinova la paura!
translation: which in the thought renews the fear!

text: Tant’è amara che poco è più morte;
translation: So bitter it is that death is little more;

text: ma per trattar del ben ch’i’ vi trovai,
translation: but to treat of the good that I found there,

text: dirò de l’altre cose ch’i’ v’ ho scorte.
translation: I will speak of the other things that I have seen there.

text: Io non so ben ridir com’i’ v’intrai,
translation: I do not know well how to retell how I entered there,

text: tant’era pien di sonno a quel punto
translation: so full of sleep was I at that point

text: che la verace via abbandonai.
translation: when I abandoned the true way.

text: Ma poi ch’i’ fui al piè d’un colle giunto,
translation: But after I had arrived at the foot of a hill,

text: là dove terminava quella valle
translation: there where that valley ended

text: che m’avea di paura il cor compunto,
translation: which had pierced my heart with fear,

text: guardai in alto e vidi le sue spalle
translation: I looked on high and saw its shoulders

text: vestite già de’ raggi del pianeta
translation: clothed already with the rays of the planet

text: che mena dritto altrui per ogne calle.
translation: that leads others straight along every path.

text: Allor fu la paura un poco queta,
translation: Then the fear was a little quieted,

text: che nel lago del cor m’era durata
translation: which in the lake of the heart had lasted in me

text: la notte ch’i’ passai con tanta pieta.
translation: the night that I passed with so much anguish.

text: E come quei che con lena affannata,
translation: And like one who with laboring breath,

text: uscito fuor del pelago a la riva,
translation: come out of the sea to the shore,

text: si volge a l’acqua perigliosa e guata,
translation: turns to the perilous water and gazes,

text: così l’animo mio, ch’ancor fuggiva,
translation: so my mind, which was still fleeing,

text: si volse a retro a rimirar lo passo
translation: turned back to look again at the pass

text: che non lasciò già mai persona viva.
translation: which never yet left a person alive.

text: Poi ch’èi posato un poco il corpo lasso,
translation: After I had rested a little the weary body,

text: ripresi via per la piaggia diserta,
translation: I took up the way again along the deserted slope,

text: sì che ’l piè fermo sempre era ’l più basso.
translation: so that the firm foot was always the lower.

text: Ed ecco, quasi al cominciar de l’erta,
translation: And behold, almost at the beginning of the ascent,

text: una lonza leggera e presta molto,
translation: a leopard light and very quick,

text: che di pel macolato era coverta;
translation: which was covered with spotted fur;

text: e non mi si partia dinanzi al volto,
translation: and it did not depart from before my face,

text: anzi ’mpediva tanto il mio cammino,
translation: but rather impeded so much my path,

text: ch’i’ fui per ritornar più volte vòlto.
translation: that I was turned many times to go back.

text: Temp’era dal principio del mattino,
translation: The time was the beginning of the morning,

text: e ’l sol montava ’n sù con quelle stelle
translation: and the sun was mounting up with those stars

text: ch’eran con lui quando l’amor divino
translation: that were with him when the divine love

text: mosse di prima quelle cose belle;
translation: first moved those beautiful things;

text: sì ch’a bene sperar m’era cagione
translation: so that for me to hope well was cause

text: di quella fiera a la gaetta pelle
translation: about that beast with the gay-colored skin

text: l’ora del tempo e la dolce stagione;
translation: the hour of the time and the sweet season;

text: ma non sì che paura non mi desse
translation: but not so that fear was not given me

text: la vista che m’apparve d’un leone.
translation: by the sight that appeared to me of a lion.

text: Questi parea che contra me venisse
translation: This one seemed that against me he was coming

text: con la test’alta e con rabbiosa fame,
translation: with the head high and with rabid hunger,

text: sì che parea che l’aere ne tremesse.
translation: so that it seemed that the air trembled at it.

text: Ed una lupa, che di tutte brame
translation: And a she-wolf, who with all cravings

text: sembiava carca ne la sua magrezza,
translation: seemed laden in her leanness,

text: e molte genti fé già viver grame,
translation: and has already made many peoples live wretched,

text: questa mi porse tanto di gravezza
translation: this one brought me so much heaviness

text: con la paura ch’uscia di sua vista,
translation: with the fear that came out of her sight,

text: ch’io perdei la speranza de l’altezza.
translation: that I lost the hope of the height.

text: E qual è quei che volontieri acquista,
translation: And like he is who willingly acquires,

text: e giugne ’l tempo che perder lo face,
translation: and the time comes that makes him lose,

text: che ’n tutti suoi pensier piange e s’attrista;
translation: who in all his thoughts weeps and grows sad;

text: tal mi fece la bestia sanza pace,
translation: such did the beast without peace make me,

text: che, venendomi ’ncontro, a poco a poco
translation: which, coming against me, little by little

text: mi ripigneva là dove ’l sol tace.
translation: was pushing me back there where the sun is silent.

text: Mentre ch’i’ rovinava in basso loco,
translation: While I was falling down into the low place,

text: dinanzi a li occhi mi si fu offerto
translation: before my eyes there was offered to me

text: chi per lungo silenzio parea fioco.
translation: one who through long silence seemed faint.

text: Quando vidi costui nel gran diserto,
translation: When I saw this one in the great desert,

text: "Miserere di me", gridai a lui,
translation: "Have mercy on me", I cried to him,

text: "qual che tu sii, od ombra od omo certo!".
translation: "whatever you are, either shade or real man!".

text: Rispuosemi: "Non omo, omo già fui,
translation: He answered me: "Not man, man once I was,

text: e li parenti miei furon lombardi,
translation: and my parents were Lombards,

text: mantoani per patrïa ambedui.
translation: Mantuans by homeland both.

text: Nacqui sub Iulio, ancor che fosse tardi,
translation: I was born under Julius, although it was late,

text: e vissi a Roma sotto ’l buono Augusto
translation: and I lived in Rome under the good Augustus

text: nel tempo de li dèi falsi e bugiardi.
translation: in the time of the false and lying gods.

text: Poeta fui, e cantai di quel giusto
translation: Poet I was, and I sang of that just

text: figliuol d’Anchise che venne di Troia,
translation: son of Anchises who came from Troy,

text: poi che ’l superbo Ilïón fu combusto.
translation: after proud Ilion was burned.

text: Ma tu perché ritorni a tanta noia?
translation: But you, why do you return to so much trouble?

text: perché non sali il dilettoso monte
translation: why do you not climb the delightful mountain

text: ch’è principio e cagion di tutta gioia?".
translation: which is beginning and cause of all joy?".

text: "Or se’ tu quel Virgilio e quella fonte
translation: "Now are you that Virgil and that fountain

text: che spandi di parlar sì largo fiume?",
translation: which spreads so wide a river of speech?",

text: rispuos’io lui con vergognosa fronte.
translation: I answered him with ashamed forehead.

text: "O de li altri poeti onore e lume,
translation: "O of the other poets honor and light,

text: vagliami ’l lungo studio e ’l grande amore
translation: may the long study and the great love avail me

text: che m’ ha fatto cercar lo tuo volume.
translation: which have made me search your volume.

text: Tu se’ lo mio maestro e ’l mio autore,
translation: You are my master and my author,

text: tu se’ solo colui da cu’ io tolsi
translation: you are the only one from whom I took

text: lo bello stilo che m’ ha fatto onore.
translation: the beautiful style that has done me honor.

text: Vedi la bestia per cu’ io mi volsi;
translation: See the beast for which I turned;

text: aiutami da lei, famoso saggio,
translation: help me from her, famous sage,

text: ch’ella mi fa tremar le vene e i polsi".
translation: for she makes my veins and pulses tremble".

text: "A te convien tenere altro vïaggio",
translation: "It is fitting for you to hold another journey",

text: rispuose, poi che lagrimar mi vide,
translation: he answered, after he saw me weeping,

text: "se vuo’ campar d’esto loco selvaggio;
translation: "if you want to escape from this savage place;

text: ché questa bestia, per la qual tu gride,
translation: for this beast, for which you cry out,

text: non lascia altrui passar per la sua via,
translation: does not let others pass along her way,

text: ma tanto lo ’mpedisce che l’uccide;
translation: but so much she impedes him that she kills him;

text: e ha natura sì malvagia e ria,
translation: and she has a nature so wicked and evil,

text: che mai non empie la bramosa voglia,
translation: that she never fills the greedy will,

text: e dopo ’l pasto ha più fame che pria.
translation: and after the meal she has more hunger than before.

text: Molti son li animali a cui s’ammoglia,
translation: Many are the animals with which she mates,

text: e più saranno ancora, infin che ’l veltro
translation: and more there will be still, until the greyhound

text: verrà, che la farà morir con doglia.
translation: will come, who will make her die with pain.

text: Questi non ciberà terra né peltro,
translation: This one will not feed on land nor pewter,

text: ma sapïenza, amore e virtute,
translation: but wisdom, love and virtue,

text: e sua nazion sarà tra feltro e feltro.
translation: and his nation will be between felt and felt.

text: Di quella umile Italia fia salute
translation: Of that humble Italy he will be salvation

text: per cui morì la vergine Cammilla,
translation: for which died the virgin Camilla,

text: Eurialo e Turno e Niso di ferute.
translation: Euryalus and Turnus and Nisus of wounds.

text: Questi la caccerà per ogne villa,
translation: This one will hunt her through every town,

text: fin che l’avrà rimessa ne lo ’nferno,
translation: until he will have put her back into Hell,

text: là onde ’nvidia prima dipartilla.
translation: there whence envy first sent her forth.

text: Ond’io per lo tuo me’ penso e discerno
translation: Whence I for your best think and discern

text: che tu mi segui, e io sarò tua guida,
translation: that you follow me, and I will be your guide,

text: e trarrotti di qui per loco etterno;
translation: and I will draw you from here through an eternal place;

text: ove udirai le disperate strida,
translation: where you will hear the desperate shrieks,

text: vedrai li antichi spiriti dolenti,
translation: you will see the ancient sorrowing spirits,

text: ch’a la seconda morte ciascun grida;
translation: who each cry out for the second death;

text: e vederai color che son contenti
translation: and you will see those who are content

text: nel foco, perché speran di venire
translation: in the fire, because they hope to come

text: quando che sia a le beate genti.
translation: whenever it may be to the blessed people.

text: A le quai poi se tu vorrai salire,
translation: To whom then if you will want to ascend,

text: anima fia a ciò più di me degna:
translation: a soul will be for that more worthy than I:

text: con lei ti lascerò nel mio partire;
translation: with her I will leave you at my departing;

text: ché quello imperador che là sù regna,
translation: for that emperor who reigns up there,

text: perch’i’ fu’ ribellante a la sua legge,
translation: because I was rebellious to his law,

text: non vuol che ’n sua città per me si vegna.
translation: does not want that into his city through me one should come.

text: In tutte parti impera e quivi regge;
translation: In all parts he governs and there he rules;

text: quivi è la sua città e l’alto seggio:
translation: there is his city and the high seat:

text: oh felice colui cu’ ivi elegge!".
translation: oh happy the one whom he chooses there!".

text: E io a lui: "Poeta, io ti richeggio
translation: And I to him: "Poet, I entreat you

text: per quello Dio che tu non conoscesti,
translation: by that God whom you did not know,

text: acciò ch’io fugga questo male e peggio,
translation: so that I may flee this evil and worse,

text: che tu mi meni là dov’or dicesti,
translation: that you lead me there where you now said,

text: sì ch’io veggia la porta di san Pietro
translation: so that I may see the gate of Saint Peter

text: e color cui tu fai cotanto mesti".
translation: and those whom you make so sorrowful".

text: Allor si mosse, e io li tenni dietro.
translation: Then he moved, and I kept behind him.

text: Lo giorno se n’andava, e l’aere bruno
translation: The day was going away, and the dark air

text: toglieva li animai che sono in terra
translation: was taking the animals that are on earth

text: da le fatiche loro; e io sol uno
translation: from their labors; and I alone

text: m’apparecchiava a sostener la guerra
translation: was preparing myself to sustain the war

text: sì del cammino e sì de la pietate,
translation: both of the journey and of the pity,

text: che ritrarrà la mente che non erra.
translation: which the mind that does not err will portray.

text: O muse, o alto ingegno, or m’aiutate;
translation: O muses, O high genius, now help me;

text: o mente che scrivesti ciò ch’io vidi,
translation: O memory that wrote down what I saw,

text: qui si parrà la tua nobilitate.
translation: here your nobility will be shown.

text: Io cominciai: "Poeta che mi guidi,
translation: I began: "Poet who guides me,

text: guarda la mia virtù s’ell’è possente,
translation: look at my power, whether it is strong enough,

text: prima ch’a l’alto passo tu mi fidi.
translation: before to the high pass you trust me.

text: Tu dici che di Silvïo il parente,
translation: You say that of Silvius the parent,

text: corruttibile ancora, ad immortale
translation: still corruptible, to the immortal

text: secolo andò, e fu sensibilmente.
translation: world went, and was there bodily.

text: Però, se l’avversario d’ogne male
translation: However, if the adversary of every evil

text: cortese i fu, pensando l’alto effetto
translation: was courteous to him, thinking of the high effect

text: ch’uscir dovea di lui, e ’l chi e ’l quale
translation: that was to come out of him, and the who and the what,

text: non pare indegno ad omo d’intelletto;
translation: it does not seem unworthy to a man of intellect;

text: ch’e’ fu de l’alma Roma e di suo impero
translation: for he was of noble Rome and of its empire

text: ne l’empireo ciel per padre eletto:
translation: in the empyrean heaven chosen as father:

text: la quale e ’l quale, a voler dir lo vero,
translation: the which and the which, to want to say the truth,

text: fu stabilita per lo loco santo
translation: were established for the holy place

text: u’ siede il successor del maggior Piero.
translation: where sits the successor of the greater Peter.

text: Per quest’andata onde li dai tu vanto,
translation: Through this going for which you give him praise,

text: intese cose che furon cagione
translation: he understood things that were the cause

text: di sua vittoria e del papale ammanto.
translation: of his victory and of the papal mantle.

text: Andovvi poi lo Vas d’elezïone,
translation: There went later the Vessel of election,

text: per recarne conforto a quella fede
translation: to bring from there comfort to that faith

text: ch’è principio a la via di salvazione.
translation: which is the beginning of the way of salvation.

text: Ma io, perché venirvi? o chi ’l concede?
translation: But I, why come there? or who allows it?

text: Io non Enëa, io non Paulo sono;
translation: I am not Aeneas, I am not Paul;

text: me degno a ciò né io né altri ’l crede.
translation: me worthy of this neither I nor others believe it.

text: Per che, se del venire io m’abbandono,
translation: Wherefore, if to the coming I abandon myself,

text: temo che la venuta non sia folle.
translation: I fear that the coming may be mad.

text: Se’ savio; intendi me’ ch’i’ non ragiono".
translation: You are wise; you understand better than I reason".

text: E qual è quei che disvuol ciò che volle
translation: And like he is who unwants what he wanted

text: e per novi pensier cangia proposta,
translation: and through new thoughts changes purpose,

text: sì che dal cominciar tutto si tolle,
translation: so that from the beginning he withdraws entirely,

text: tal mi fec’ïo ’n quella oscura costa,
translation: such I made myself on that dark slope,

text: perché, pensando, consumai la ’mpresa
translation: because, thinking, I consumed the enterprise

text: che fu nel cominciar cotanto tosta.
translation: which was in the beginning so quick.

text: "S’i’ ho ben la parola tua intesa",
translation: "If I have well understood your word",

text: rispuose del magnanimo quell’ombra,
translation: answered that shade of the magnanimous one,

text: "l’anima tua è da viltade offesa;
translation: "your soul is offended by cowardice;

text: la qual molte fïate l’omo ingombra
translation: which many times encumbers man

text: sì che d’onrata impresa lo rivolve,
translation: so that from an honored enterprise it turns him back,

text: come falso veder bestia quand’ombra.
translation: as false seeing does a beast when it shies.

text: Da questa tema acciò che tu ti solve,
translation: So that you may free yourself from this fear,

text: dirotti perch’io venni e quel ch’io ’ntesi
translation: I will tell you why I came and what I heard

text: nel primo punto che di te mi dolve.
translation: at the first point that I grieved for you.

text: Io era tra color che son sospesi,
translation: I was among those who are suspended,

text: e donna mi chiamò beata e bella,
translation: and a lady called me, blessed and beautiful,

text: tal che di comandare io la richiesi.
translation: such that I asked her to command.

text: Lucevan li occhi suoi più che la stella;
translation: Her eyes were shining more than the star;

text: e cominciommi a dir soave e piana,
translation: and she began to say to me, gentle and soft,

text: con angelica voce, in sua favella:
translation: with angelic voice, in her speech:

text: "O anima cortese mantoana,
translation: "O courteous Mantuan soul,

text: di cui la fama ancor nel mondo dura,
translation: of whom the fame still in the world lasts,

text: e durerà quanto ’l mondo lontana,
translation: and will last as long as the world, far,

text: l’amico mio, e non de la ventura,
translation: my friend, and not of fortune,

text: ne la diserta piaggia è impedito
translation: on the deserted slope is impeded

text: sì nel cammin, che vòlt’è per paura;
translation: so on the path, that he has turned back for fear;

text: e temo che non sia già sì smarrito,
translation: and I fear that he may be already so lost,

text: ch’io mi sia tardi al soccorso levata,
translation: that I may have risen late to the rescue,

text: per quel ch’i’ ho di lui nel cielo udito.
translation: from what I have heard of him in heaven.

text: Or movi, e con la tua parola ornata
translation: Now move, and with your ornate word

text: e con ciò c’ ha mestieri al suo campare,
translation: and with what is needed for his escaping,

text: l’aiuta sì ch’i’ ne sia consolata.
translation: help him so that I may be consoled by it.

text: I’ son Beatrice che ti faccio andare;
translation: I am Beatrice who makes you go;

text: vegno del loco ove tornar disio;
translation: I come from the place where I desire to return;

text: amor mi mosse, che mi fa parlare.
translation: love moved me, which makes me speak.

text: Quando sarò dinanzi al segnor mio,
translation: When I will be before my lord,

text: di te mi loderò sovente a lui".
translation: I will praise myself of you often to him".

text: Tacette allora, e poi comincia’ io:
translation: She fell silent then, and then I began:

text: "O donna di virtù sola per cui
translation: "O lady of virtue, alone through whom

text: l’umana spezie eccede ogne contento
translation: the human species exceeds all that is contained

text: di quel ciel c’ ha minor li cerchi sui,
translation: by that heaven which has its circles smallest,

text: tanto m’aggrada il tuo comandamento,
translation: so much your command pleases me,

text: che l’ubidir, se già fosse, m’è tardi;
translation: that the obeying, if it were already done, is late for me;

text: più non t’è uo’ ch’aprirmi il tuo talento.
translation: there is no more need for you but to open to me your wish.

text: Ma dimmi la cagion che non ti guardi
translation: But tell me the reason why you do not beware

text: de lo scender qua giuso in questo centro
translation: of the descending down here into this center

text: de l’ampio loco ove tornar tu ardi".
translation: from the ample place where you burn to return".

text: "Da che tu vuo’ saver cotanto a dentro,
translation: "Since you want to know so far within,

text: dirotti brievemente", mi rispuose,
translation: I will tell you briefly", she answered me,

text: "perch’i’ non temo di venir qua entro.
translation: "why I do not fear to come in here.

text: Temer si dee di sole quelle cose
translation: One must fear only those things

text: c’ hanno potenza di fare altrui male;
translation: that have power to do others harm;

text: de l’altre no, ché non son paurose.
translation: of the others no, for they are not fearful.

text: I’ son fatta da Dio, sua mercé, tale,
translation: I am made by God, his mercy, such,

text: che la vostra miseria non mi tange,
translation: that your misery does not touch me,

text: né fiamma d’esto ’ncendio non m’assale.
translation: nor does flame of this fire assail me.

text: Donna è gentil nel ciel che si compiange
translation: There is a gentle lady in heaven who grieves

text: di questo ’mpedimento ov’io ti mando,
translation: over this impediment where I send you,

text: sì che duro giudicio là sù frange.
translation: so that she breaks hard judgment up there.

text: Questa chiese Lucia in suo dimando
translation: This one called Lucia in her request

text: e disse: - Or ha bisogno il tuo fedele
translation: and said: - Now has need your faithful one

text: di te, e io a te lo raccomando -.
translation: of you, and I to you commend him -.

text: Lucia, nimica di ciascun crudele,
translation: Lucia, enemy of everyone cruel,

text: si mosse, e venne al loco dov’i’ era,
translation: moved, and came to the place where I was,

text: che mi sedea con l’antica Rachele.
translation: where I was sitting with the ancient Rachel.

text: Disse: - Beatrice, loda di Dio vera,
translation: She said: - Beatrice, true praise of God,

text: ché non soccorri quei che t’amò tanto,
translation: why do you not help him who loved you so much,

text: ch’uscì per te de la volgare schiera?
translation: that he came out for you from the common crowd?

text: Non odi tu la pieta del suo pianto,
translation: Do you not hear the anguish of his weeping,

text: non vedi tu la morte che ’l combatte
translation: do you not see the death that fights him

text: su la fiumana ove ’l mar non ha vanto? -.
translation: on the flood over which the sea has no boast? -.

text: Al mondo non fur mai persone ratte
translation: In the world there were never persons swift

text: a far lor pro o a fuggir lor danno,
translation: to do their profit or to flee their harm,

text: com’io, dopo cotai parole fatte,
translation: as I, after such words were made,

text: venni qua giù del mio beato scanno,
translation: came down here from my blessed seat,

text: fidandomi del tuo parlare onesto,
translation: trusting myself to your honest speech,

text: ch’onora te e quei ch’udito l’ hanno".
translation: which honors you and those who have heard it".

text: Poscia che m’ebbe ragionato questo,
translation: After she had spoken this to me,

text: li occhi lucenti lagrimando volse,
translation: her shining eyes weeping she turned,

text: per che mi fece del venir più presto.
translation: wherefore she made me quicker in coming.

text: E venni a te così com’ella volse:
translation: And I came to you just as she wished:

text: d’inanzi a quella fiera ti levai
translation: from before that beast I took you away

text: che del bel monte il corto andar ti tolse.
translation: which from the beautiful mountain took from you the short going.

text: Dunque: che è perché, perché restai,
translation: So: what is it, why, why do you stay,

text: perché tanta viltà nel core allette,
translation: why do you harbor such cowardice in the heart,

text: perché ardire e franchezza non hai,
translation: why do you not have daring and boldness,

text: poscia che tai tre donne benedette
translation: since three such blessed ladies

text: curan di te ne la corte del cielo,
translation: care for you in the court of heaven,

text: e ’l mio parlar tanto ben ti promette?".
translation: and my speech promises you so much good?".

text: Quali fioretti dal notturno gelo
translation: As little flowers by the nightly frost

text: chinati e chiusi, poi che ’l sol li ’mbianca,
translation: bent and closed, after the sun whitens them,

text: si drizzan tutti aperti in loro stelo,
translation: straighten themselves all open on their stem,

text: tal mi fec’io di mia virtude stanca,
translation: such I made myself with my tired power,

text: e tanto buono ardire al cor mi corse,
translation: and so much good daring ran to my heart,

text: ch’i’ cominciai come persona franca:
translation: that I began like a person freed:

text: "Oh pietosa colei che mi soccorse!
translation: "Oh compassionate she who helped me!

text: e te cortese ch’ubidisti tosto
translation: and you courteous who obeyed quickly

text: a le vere parole che ti porse!
translation: the true words that she offered you!

text: Tu m’ hai con disiderio il cor disposto
translation: You have with desire disposed my heart

text: sì al venir con le parole tue,
translation: so to the coming with your words,

text: ch’i’ son tornato nel primo proposto.
translation: that I have returned to the first purpose.

text: Or va, ch’un sol volere è d’ambedue:
translation: Now go, for one single will is of both:

text: tu duca, tu segnore e tu maestro".
translation: you leader, you lord and you master".

text: Così li dissi; e poi che mosso fue,
translation: So I said to him; and after he had moved,

text: intrai per lo cammino alto e silvestro.
translation: I entered along the path deep and wild.

text: ’Per me si va ne la città dolente,
translation: 'Through me one goes into the sorrowful city,

text: per me si va ne l'etterno dolore,
translation: through me one goes into the eternal sorrow,

text: per me si va tra la perduta gente.
translation: through me one goes among the lost people.

text: Giustizia mosse il mio alto fattore;
translation: Justice moved my high maker;

text: fecemi la divina podestate,
translation: the divine power made me,

text: la somma sapïenza e ’l primo amore.
translation: the highest wisdom and the first love.

text: Dinanzi a me non fuor cose create
translation: Before me there were no things created

text: se non etterne, e io etterno duro.
translation: if not eternal, and I eternal last.

text: Lasciate ogne speranza, voi ch’intrate’.
translation: Abandon every hope, you who enter'.

text: Queste parole di colore oscuro
translation: These words of dark color

text: vid’ïo scritte al sommo d’una porta;
translation: I saw written at the top of a gate;

text: per ch’io: "Maestro, il senso lor m’è duro".
translation: wherefore I: "Master, their meaning is hard for me".

text: Ed elli a me, come persona accorta:
translation: And he to me, like a perceptive person:

text: "Qui si convien lasciare ogne sospetto;
translation: "Here it is fitting to abandon every suspicion;

text: ogne viltà convien che qui sia morta.
translation: every cowardice it is fitting that here be dead.

text: Noi siam venuti al loco ov’i’ t’ ho detto
translation: We have come to the place where I have told you

text: che tu vedrai le genti dolorose
translation: that you will see the sorrowful people

text: c’ hanno perduto il ben de l’intelletto".
translation: who have lost the good of the intellect".

text: E poi che la sua mano a la mia puose
translation: And after he had put his hand on mine

text: con lieto volto, ond’io mi confortai,
translation: with a glad face, whence I was comforted,

text: mi mise dentro a le segrete cose.
translation: he put me inside to the secret things.

text: Quivi sospiri, pianti e alti guai
translation: There sighs, laments and loud wails

text: risonavan per l’aere sanza stelle,
translation: resounded through the air without stars,

text: per ch’io al cominciar ne lagrimai.
translation: so that I at the beginning wept at it.

text: Diverse lingue, orribili favelle,
translation: Diverse tongues, horrible speeches,

text: parole di dolore, accenti d’ira,
translation: words of pain, accents of anger,

text: voci alte e fioche, e suon di man con elle
translation: voices loud and faint, and sound of hands with them

text: facevano un tumulto, il qual s’aggira
translation: were making a tumult, which whirls

text: sempre in quell’aura sanza tempo tinta,
translation: always in that air forever dyed,

text: come la rena quando turbo spira.
translation: like the sand when the whirlwind breathes.

text: E io ch’avea d’error la testa cinta,
translation: And I, who had my head girt with error,

text: dissi: "Maestro, che è quel ch’i’ odo?
translation: said: "Master, what is that which I hear?

text: e che gent’è che par nel duol sì vinta?".
translation: and what people is it that seems so vanquished by pain?".

text: Ed elli a me: "Questo misero modo
translation: And he to me: "This miserable mode

text: tegnon l’anime triste di coloro
translation: the wretched souls of those maintain

text: che visser sanza ’nfamia e sanza lodo.
translation: who lived without infamy and without praise.

text: Mischiate sono a quel cattivo coro
translation: Mingled they are with that base choir

text: de li angeli che non furon ribelli
translation: of the angels who were not rebels

text: né fur fedeli a Dio, ma per sé fuoro.
translation: nor were faithful to God, but were for themselves.

text: Caccianli i ciel per non esser men belli,
translation: The heavens chase them out so as not to be less beautiful,

text: né lo profondo inferno li riceve,
translation: nor does the deep hell receive them,

text: ch’alcuna gloria i rei avrebber d’elli".
translation: for the guilty would have some glory from them".

text: E io: "Maestro, che è tanto greve
translation: And I: "Master, what is so heavy

text: a lor che lamentar li fa sì forte?".
translation: to them that it makes them lament so strongly?".

text: Rispuose: "Dicerolti molto breve.
translation: He answered: "I will tell it to you very briefly.

text: Questi non hanno speranza di morte,
translation: These have no hope of death,

text: e la lor cieca vita è tanto bassa,
translation: and their blind life is so low,

text: che ’nvidïosi son d’ogne altra sorte.
translation: that envious they are of every other lot.

text: Fama di loro il mondo esser non lassa;
translation: Fame of them the world does not allow to be;

text: misericordia e giustizia li sdegna:
translation: mercy and justice disdain them:

text: non ragioniam di lor, ma guarda e passa".
translation: let us not speak of them, but look and pass".

text: E io, che riguardai, vidi una ’nsegna
translation: And I, who looked again, saw a banner

text: che girando correva tanto ratta,
translation: that, circling, was running so swift,

text: che d’ogne posa mi parea indegna;
translation: that of any rest it seemed to me unworthy;

text: e dietro le venìa sì lunga tratta
translation: and behind it there came so long a train

text: di gente, ch’i’ non averei creduto
translation: of people, that I would not have believed

text: che morte tanta n’avesse disfatta.
translation: that death had undone so many.

text: Poscia ch’io v’ebbi alcun riconosciuto,
translation: After I had recognized some there,

text: vidi e conobbi l’ombra di colui
translation: I saw and knew the shade of him

text: che fece per viltade il gran rifiuto.
translation: who made through cowardice the great refusal.

text: Incontanente intesi e certo fui
translation: Immediately I understood and was certain

text: che questa era la setta d’i cattivi,
translation: that this was the sect of the base ones,

text: a Dio spiacenti e a’ nemici sui.
translation: displeasing to God and to his enemies.

text: Questi sciaurati, che mai non fur vivi,
translation: These wretches, who were never alive,

text: erano ignudi e stimolati molto
translation: were naked and stung much

text: da mosconi e da vespe ch’eran ivi.
translation: by gadflies and by wasps that were there.

text: Elle rigavan lor di sangue il volto,
translation: These streaked their face with blood,

text: che, mischiato di lagrime, a’ lor piedi
translation: which, mingled with tears, at their feet

text: da fastidiosi vermi era ricolto.
translation: by loathsome worms was gathered up.

text: E poi ch’a riguardar oltre mi diedi,
translation: And after I gave myself to looking beyond,

text: vidi genti a la riva d’un gran fiume;
translation: I saw people at the bank of a great river;

text: per ch’io dissi: "Maestro, or mi concedi
translation: wherefore I said: "Master, now grant me

text: ch’i’ sappia quali sono, e qual costume
translation: that I may know who they are, and what custom

text: le fa di trapassar parer sì pronte,
translation: makes them seem so ready to cross over,

text: com’i’ discerno per lo fioco lume".
translation: as I discern through the faint light".

text: Ed elli a me: "Le cose ti fier conte
translation: And he to me: "The things will be made known to you

text: quando noi fermerem li nostri passi
translation: when we will stop our steps

text: su la trista riviera d’Acheronte".
translation: on the sad shore of Acheron".

text: Allor con li occhi vergognosi e bassi,
translation: Then with eyes ashamed and low,

text: temendo no ’l mio dir li fosse grave,
translation: fearing lest my speaking be burdensome to him,

text: infino al fiume del parlar mi trassi.
translation: until the river I withdrew from speaking.

text: Ed ecco verso noi venir per nave
translation: And behold toward us coming by boat

text: un vecchio, bianco per antico pelo,
translation: an old man, white with ancient hair,

text: gridando: "Guai a voi, anime prave!
translation: crying: "Woe to you, wicked souls!

text: Non isperate mai veder lo cielo:
translation: Do not hope ever to see the heaven:

text: i’ vegno per menarvi a l’altra riva
translation: I come to lead you to the other bank

text: ne le tenebre etterne, in caldo e ’n gelo.
translation: into the eternal darkness, into heat and into frost.

text: E tu che se’ costì, anima viva,
translation: And you who are there, living soul,

text: pàrtiti da cotesti che son morti".
translation: depart from these who are dead".

text: Ma poi che vide ch’io non mi partiva,
translation: But after he saw that I did not depart,

text: disse: "Per altra via, per altri porti
translation: he said: "By another way, by other ports

text: verrai a piaggia, non qui, per passare:
translation: you will come to shore, not here, for passing:

text: più lieve legno convien che ti porti".
translation: a lighter vessel must carry you".

text: E ’l duca lui: "Caron, non ti crucciare:
translation: And the leader to him: "Charon, do not torment yourself:

text: vuolsi così colà dove si puote
translation: it is willed so there where one can do

text: ciò che si vuole, e più non dimandare".
translation: what one wills, and ask no more".

text: Quinci fuor quete le lanose gote
translation: Hence were quieted the woolly cheeks

text: al nocchier de la livida palude,
translation: of the pilot of the livid marsh,

text: che ’ntorno a li occhi avea di fiamme rote.
translation: who around the eyes had wheels of flames.

text: Ma quell’anime, ch’eran lasse e nude,
translation: But those souls, who were weary and naked,

text: cangiar colore e dibattero i denti,
translation: changed color and gnashed their teeth,

text: ratto che ’nteser le parole crude.
translation: as soon as they heard the cruel words.

text: Bestemmiavano Dio e lor parenti,
translation: They blasphemed God and their parents,

text: l’umana spezie e ’l loco e ’l tempo e ’l seme
translation: the human species and the place and the time and the seed

text: di lor semenza e di lor nascimenti.
translation: of their sowing and of their births.

text: Poi si ritrasser tutte quante insieme,
translation: Then they drew back all of them together,

text: forte piangendo, a la riva malvagia
translation: loudly weeping, to the evil shore

text: ch’attende ciascun uom che Dio non teme.
translation: which awaits every man who does not fear God.

text: Caron dimonio, con occhi di bragia
translation: Charon demon, with eyes of burning coal

text: loro accennando, tutte le raccoglie;
translation: beckoning them, gathers them all;

text: batte col remo qualunque s'adagia.
translation: he beats with the oar whoever lingers.

text: Come d’autunno si levan le foglie
translation: As in autumn the leaves lift away

text: l’una appresso de l’altra, fin che ’l ramo
translation: one after the other, until the branch

text: vede a la terra tutte le sue spoglie,
translation: sees on the ground all its spoils,

text: similemente il mal seme d’Adamo
translation: similarly the evil seed of Adam

text: gittansi di quel lito ad una ad una,
translation: throw themselves from that shore one by one,

text: per cenni come augel per suo richiamo.
translation: at signals like a bird at its call.

text: Così sen vanno su per l’onda bruna,
translation: So they go away over the dark wave,

text: e avanti che sien di là discese,
translation: and before they have landed over there,

text: anche di qua nuova schiera s’auna.
translation: already on this side a new throng gathers.

text: "Figliuol mio", disse 'l maestro cortese,
translation: "My son", said the courteous master,

text: "quelli che muoion ne l'ira di Dio
translation: "those who die in the wrath of God

text: tutti convegnon qui d'ogne paese;
translation: all gather here from every land;

text: e pronti sono a trapassar lo rio,
translation: and ready they are to cross the river,

text: ché la divina giustizia li sprona,
translation: for the divine justice spurs them,

text: sì che la tema si volve in disio.
translation: so that the fear turns into desire.

text: Quinci non passa mai anima buona;
translation: From here never passes a good soul;

text: e però, se Caron di te si lagna,
translation: and therefore, if Charon complains of you,

text: ben puoi sapere omai che ’l suo dir suona".
translation: well can you know now what his speech means".

text: Finito questo, la buia campagna
translation: This finished, the dark countryside

text: tremò sì forte, che de lo spavento
translation: trembled so strongly, that of the terror

text: la mente di sudore ancor mi bagna.
translation: the memory with sweat still bathes me.

text: La terra lagrimosa diede vento,
translation: The tearful land gave forth wind,

text: che balenò una luce vermiglia
translation: which flashed a vermilion light

text: la qual mi vinse ciascun sentimento;
translation: which overcame in me every sense;

text: e caddi come l’uom cui sonno piglia.
translation: and I fell like the man whom sleep seizes.

text: Ruppemi l’alto sonno ne la testa
translation: There broke the deep sleep in my head

text: un greve truono, sì ch’io mi riscossi
translation: a heavy thunder, so that I started up

text: come persona ch’è per forza desta;
translation: like a person who is by force awakened;

text: e l’occhio riposato intorno mossi,
translation: and the rested eye around I moved,

text: dritto levato, e fiso riguardai
translation: risen upright, and fixedly I looked

text: per conoscer lo loco dov’io fossi.
translation: to know the place where I was.

text: Vero è che ’n su la proda mi trovai
translation: True it is that on the brink I found myself

text: de la valle d’abisso dolorosa
translation: of the valley of the sorrowful abyss

text: che ’ntrono accoglie d’infiniti guai.
translation: which gathers the thunder of infinite wails.

text: Oscura e profonda era e nebulosa
translation: Dark and deep it was and cloudy

text: tanto che, per ficcar lo viso a fondo,
translation: so much that, for fixing the sight to the bottom,

text: io non vi discernea alcuna cosa.
translation: I did not discern there anything.

text: "Or discendiam qua giù nel cieco mondo",
translation: "Now let us descend down here into the blind world",

text: cominciò il poeta tutto smorto.
translation: began the poet all pale.

text: "Io sarò primo, e tu sarai secondo".
translation: "I will be first, and you will be second".

text: E io, che del color mi fui accorto,
translation: And I, who had become aware of the color,

text: dissi: "Come verrò, se tu paventi
translation: said: "How will I come, if you are afraid

text: che suoli al mio dubbiare esser conforto?".
translation: who are accustomed to be comfort to my doubting?".

text: Ed elli a me: "L’angoscia de le genti
translation: And he to me: "The anguish of the people

text: che son qua giù, nel viso mi dipigne
translation: who are down here, on my face paints

text: quella pietà che tu per tema senti.
translation: that pity which you take for fear.

text: Andiam, ché la via lunga ne sospigne".
translation: Let us go, for the long way urges us".

text: Così si mise e così mi fé intrare
translation: So he set out and so he made me enter

text: nel primo cerchio che l’abisso cigne.
translation: into the first circle that girds the abyss.

text: Quivi, secondo che per ascoltare,
translation: There, according to what one could tell by listening,

text: non avea pianto mai che di sospiri
translation: there was no weeping but of sighs

text: che l’aura etterna facevan tremare;
translation: which made the eternal air tremble;

text: ciò avvenia di duol sanza martìri,
translation: this arose from sorrow without torments,

text: ch’avean le turbe, ch’eran molte e grandi,
translation: which the crowds had, which were many and great,

text: d’infanti e di femmine e di viri.
translation: of infants and of women and of men.

text: Lo buon maestro a me: "Tu non dimandi
translation: The good master to me: "You do not ask

text: che spiriti son questi che tu vedi?
translation: what spirits are these that you see?

text: Or vo’ che sappi, innanzi che più andi,
translation: Now I want that you know, before you go further,

text: ch’ei non peccaro; e s’elli hanno mercedi,
translation: that they did not sin; and if they have merits,

text: non basta, perché non ebber battesmo,
translation: it is not enough, because they did not have baptism,

text: ch’è porta de la fede che tu credi;
translation: which is the gate of the faith that you believe;

text: e s’e’ furon dinanzi al cristianesmo,
translation: and if they were before Christianity,

text: non adorar debitamente a Dio:
translation: they did not adore God duly:

text: e di questi cotai son io medesmo.
translation: and of these such am I myself.

text: Per tai difetti, non per altro rio,
translation: For such defects, not for other guilt,

text: semo perduti, e sol di tanto offesi
translation: we are lost, and only so far harmed

text: che sanza speme vivemo in disio".
translation: that without hope we live in desire".

text: Gran duol mi prese al cor quando lo ’ntesi,
translation: Great grief seized me at the heart when I heard it,

text: però che gente di molto valore
translation: because people of much worth

text: conobbi che ’n quel limbo eran sospesi.
translation: I knew who in that limbo were suspended.

text: "Dimmi, maestro mio, dimmi, segnore",
translation: "Tell me, my master, tell me, lord",

text: comincia’ io per volere esser certo
translation: I began, wanting to be certain

text: di quella fede che vince ogne errore:
translation: of that faith which conquers every error:

text: "uscicci mai alcuno, o per suo merto
translation: "did anyone ever go out from here, either by his merit

text: o per altrui, che poi fosse beato?".
translation: or by another's, who afterward was blessed?".

text: E quei che ’ntese il mio parlar coverto,
translation: And he who understood my covert speech,

text: rispuose: "Io era nuovo in questo stato,
translation: answered: "I was new in this state,

text: quando ci vidi venire un possente,
translation: when I saw come here a mighty one,

text: con segno di vittoria coronato.
translation: with sign of victory crowned.

text: Trasseci l’ombra del primo parente,
translation: He drew out from here the shade of the first parent,

text: d’Abèl suo figlio e quella di Noè,
translation: of Abel his son and that of Noah,

text: di Moïsè legista e ubidente;
translation: of Moses lawgiver and obedient;

text: Abraàm patrïarca e Davìd re,
translation: Abraham patriarch and David king,

text: Israèl con lo padre e co’ suoi nati
translation: Israel with his father and with his children

text: e con Rachele, per cui tanto fé,
translation: and with Rachel, for whom he did so much,

text: e altri molti, e feceli beati.
translation: and many others, and he made them blessed.

text: E vo’ che sappi che, dinanzi ad essi,
translation: And I want you to know that, before them,

text: spiriti umani non eran salvati".
translation: human spirits were not saved".

text: Non lasciavam l’andar perch’ei dicessi,
translation: We did not leave off going because he was speaking,

text: ma passavam la selva tuttavia,
translation: but we were passing the forest all the while,

text: la selva, dico, di spiriti spessi.
translation: the forest, I say, of thick spirits.

text: Non era lunga ancor la nostra via
translation: Not yet long was our way

text: di qua dal sonno, quand’io vidi un foco
translation: on this side of the sleep, when I saw a fire

text: ch’emisperio di tenebre vincia.
translation: which a hemisphere of darkness was overcoming.

text: Di lungi n’eravamo ancora un poco,
translation: We were still a little distant from it,

text: ma non sì ch’io non discernessi in parte
translation: but not so that I did not discern in part

text: ch’orrevol gente possedea quel loco.
translation: that honorable people possessed that place.

text: "O tu ch’onori scïenzïa e arte,
translation: "O you who honor science and art,

text: questi chi son c’ hanno cotanta onranza,
translation: who are these who have so much honor,

text: che dal modo de li altri li diparte?".
translation: that it parts them from the manner of the others?".

text: E quelli a me: "L’onrata nominanza
translation: And he to me: "The honored renown

text: che di lor suona sù ne la tua vita,
translation: that sounds of them up in your life,

text: grazïa acquista in ciel che sì li avanza".
translation: acquires grace in heaven which so advances them".

text: Intanto voce fu per me udita:
translation: Meanwhile a voice was heard by me:

text: "Onorate l’altissimo poeta;
translation: "Honor the highest poet;

text: l’ombra sua torna, ch’era dipartita".
translation: his shade returns, which had departed".

text: Poi che la voce fu restata e queta,
translation: After the voice had stopped and was quiet,

text: vidi quattro grand’ombre a noi venire:
translation: I saw four great shades come to us:

text: sembianz’avevan né trista né lieta.
translation: they had a semblance neither sad nor glad.

text: Lo buon maestro cominciò a dire:
translation: The good master began to say:

text: "Mira colui con quella spada in mano,
translation: "Look at him with that sword in hand,

text: che vien dinanzi ai tre sì come sire:
translation: who comes before the three just like a lord:

text: quelli è Omero poeta sovrano;
translation: that one is Homer, sovereign poet;

text: l’altro è Orazio satiro che vene;
translation: the other is Horace the satirist who comes;

text: Ovidio è ’l terzo, e l’ultimo Lucano.
translation: Ovid is the third, and the last Lucan.

text: Però che ciascun meco si convene
translation: Because each one agrees with me

text: nel nome che sonò la voce sola,
translation: in the name that the single voice sounded,

text: fannomi onore, e di ciò fanno bene".
translation: they do me honor, and in that they do well".

text: Così vid’i’ adunar la bella scola
translation: So I saw assemble the beautiful school

text: di quel segnor de l’altissimo canto
translation: of that lord of the highest song

text: che sovra li altri com’aquila vola.
translation: who above the others like an eagle flies.

text: Da ch’ebber ragionato insieme alquanto,
translation: After they had talked together somewhat,

text: volsersi a me con salutevol cenno,
translation: they turned to me with a sign of greeting,

text: e ’l mio maestro sorrise di tanto;
translation: and my master smiled at so much;

text: e più d’onore ancora assai mi fenno,
translation: and more of honor still by far they did me,

text: ch’e’ sì mi fecer de la loro schiera,
translation: for they made me of their band,

text: sì ch’io fui sesto tra cotanto senno.
translation: so that I was sixth among so much wisdom.

text: Così andammo infino a la lumera,
translation: Thus we went as far as the light,

text: parlando cose che ’l tacere è bello,
translation: speaking things about which silence is beautiful,

text: sì com’era ’l parlar colà dov’era.
translation: just as the speaking was there where I was.

text: Venimmo al piè d’un nobile castello,
translation: We came to the foot of a noble castle,

text: sette volte cerchiato d’alte mura,
translation: seven times circled by high walls,

text: difeso intorno d’un bel fiumicello.
translation: defended around by a beautiful little river.

text: Questo passammo come terra dura;
translation: This we passed as if dry land;

text: per sette porte intrai con questi savi:
translation: through seven gates I entered with these sages:

text: giugnemmo in prato di fresca verdura.
translation: we arrived at a meadow of fresh verdure.

text: Genti v’eran con occhi tardi e gravi,
translation: People were there with eyes slow and grave,

text: di grande autorità ne’ lor sembianti:
translation: of great authority in their semblances:

text: parlavan rado, con voci soavi.
translation: they spoke seldom, with gentle voices.

translation: Of your city I am, and always

translation: your deeds and the honored names

text: con affezion ritrassi e ascoltai.
translation: with affection I have retold and heard.

translation: I leave the gall and go for sweet fruits

text: promessi a me per lo verace duca;
translation: promised to me by the truthful leader;

translation: but as far as the center first I must fall".

translation: "So may the soul long guide

translation: "and so may your fame shine after you,

translation: say whether courtesy and valor dwell

text: ne la nostra città sì come suole,
translation: in our city as they used to,

text: o se del tutto se n’è gita fora;
translation: or whether they have altogether gone out of it;

text: ché Guiglielmo Borsiere, il qual si duole
translation: for Guglielmo Borsiere, who laments

text: con noi per poco e va là coi compagni,
translation: with us but a short while and goes there with the companions,

text: assai ne cruccia con le sue parole".
translation: greatly grieves us with his words".

text: "La gente nuova e i sùbiti guadagni
translation: "The new people and the sudden gains

text: orgoglio e dismisura han generata,
translation: have generated pride and excess,

text: Fiorenza, in te, sì che tu già ten piagni".
translation: Florence, in you, so that already you weep for it".

translation: So I cried with my face lifted;

text: e i tre, che ciò inteser per risposta,
translation: and the three, who took that for answer,

text: guardar l’un l’altro com’al ver si guata.
translation: looked at each other as one gazes at the truth.

text: "Se l’altre volte sì poco ti costa",
translation: "If other times it costs you so little",

text: rispuoser tutti, "il satisfare altrui,
translation: they all answered, "to satisfy others,

text: felice te se sì parli a tua posta!
translation: happy you if you speak thus at your pleasure!

text: Però, se campi d’esti luoghi bui
translation: Therefore, if you escape from these dark places

text: e torni a riveder le belle stelle,
translation: and return to see again the beautiful stars,

text: quando ti gioverà dicere "I’ fui",
translation: when it will please you to say 'I was',

text: fa che di noi a la gente favelle".
translation: see that you speak of us to people".

translation: Then they broke the wheel, and in fleeing

text: ali sembiar le gambe loro isnelle.
translation: their swift legs seemed wings.

translation: An amen could not have been said

text: tosto così com’e’ fuoro spariti;
translation: as quickly as they had vanished;

text: per ch’al maestro parve di partirsi.
translation: wherefore it seemed good to the master to depart.

text: Io lo seguiva, e poco eravam iti,
translation: I was following him, and we had gone a little,

text: che ’l suon de l’acqua n’era sì vicino,
translation: when the sound of the water was so near us,

text: che per parlar saremmo a pena uditi.
translation: that for speaking we would hardly have been heard.

text: Come quel fiume c’ ha proprio cammino
translation: As that river which has its own course

text: prima dal Monte Viso ’nver’ levante,
translation: first from Monte Viso toward the east,

text: da la sinistra costa d’Apennino,
translation: on the left slope of the Apennine,

text: che si chiama Acquacheta suso, avante
translation: which is called Acquacheta above, before

text: che si divalli giù nel basso letto,
translation: it descends down into the low bed,

text: e a Forlì di quel nome è vacante,
translation: and at Forlì is empty of that name,

text: rimbomba là sovra San Benedetto
translation: resounds there above San Benedetto

text: de l’Alpe per cadere ad una scesa
translation: of the Alps by falling in one descent

text: ove dovea per mille esser recetto;
translation: where it should have been received by a thousand;

text: così, giù d’una ripa discoscesa,
translation: so, down from a steep bank,

text: trovammo risonar quell’acqua tinta,
translation: we found resounding that dark water,

text: sì che ’n poc’ora avria l’orecchia offesa.
translation: so that in a short time it would have harmed the ear.

text: Io avea una corda intorno cinta,
translation: I had a cord girded around me,

text: e con essa pensai alcuna volta
translation: and with it I thought at one time

text: prender la lonza a la pelle dipinta.
translation: to catch the leopard with the painted skin.

text: Poscia ch’io l’ebbi tutta da me sciolta,
translation: After I had loosed it all from me,

text: sì come ’l duca m’avea comandato,
translation: just as the leader had commanded me,

text: porsila a lui aggroppata e ravvolta.
translation: I held it out to him knotted and coiled.

text: Ond’ei si volse inver’ lo destro lato,
translation: Whereupon he turned toward the right side,

text: e alquanto di lunge da la sponda
translation: and somewhat far from the edge

text: la gittò giuso in quell’alto burrato.
translation: he threw it down into that deep ravine.

text: ’E’ pur convien che novità risponda’,
translation: 'It must be that something new answers',

text: dicea fra me medesmo, ’al novo cenno
translation: I was saying within myself, 'the new signal

text: che ’l maestro con l’occhio sì seconda’.
translation: which the master so follows with his eye'.

text: Ahi quanto cauti li uomini esser dienno
translation: Ah how cautious men should be

text: presso a color che non veggion pur l'ovra,
translation: near those who do not see only the deed,

text: ma per entro i pensier miran col senno!
translation: but look into the thoughts with their wisdom!

text: El disse a me: "Tosto verrà di sovra
translation: He said to me: "Soon will come up above

text: ciò ch’io attendo e che il tuo pensier sogna;
translation: what I await and what your thought dreams;

text: tosto convien ch’al tuo viso si scovra".
translation: soon must it be uncovered to your sight".

text: Sempre a quel ver c' ha faccia di menzogna
translation: Always to that truth which has the face of a lie

text: de' l'uom chiuder le labbra fin ch'el puote,
translation: a man should close his lips as long as he can,

text: però che sanza colpa fa vergogna;
translation: because without fault it brings shame;

text: ma qui tacer nol posso; e per le note
translation: but here I cannot be silent about it; and by the notes

text: di questa comedìa, lettor, ti giuro,
translation: of this comedy, reader, I swear to you,

text: s’elle non sien di lunga grazia vòte,
translation: so may they not be empty of lasting favor,

text: ch’i’ vidi per quell’ aere grosso e scuro
translation: that I saw through that air thick and dark

text: venir notando una figura in suso,
translation: come swimming upward a figure,

text: maravigliosa ad ogne cor sicuro,
translation: marvelous to every steady heart,

text: sì come torna colui che va giuso
translation: just as he returns who goes down

text: talora a solver l’àncora ch’aggrappa
translation: at times to loosen the anchor that grapples

text: o scoglio o altro che nel mare è chiuso,
translation: either a reef or something else that is hidden in the sea,

text: che ’n sù si stende e da piè si rattrappa.
translation: who stretches upward and draws in his feet.

text: "Ecco la fiera con la coda aguzza,
translation: "Behold the beast with the pointed tail,

text: che passa i monti e rompe i muri e l'armi!
translation: which passes mountains and breaks walls and weapons!

text: Ecco colei che tutto 'l mondo appuzza!".
translation: Behold her who makes the whole world stink!".

text: Sì cominciò lo mio duca a parlarmi;
translation: So began my leader to speak to me;

text: e accennolle che venisse a proda,
translation: and he beckoned to it that it should come to shore,

text: vicino al fin d’i passeggiati marmi.
translation: near the end of the walked-upon marbles.

text: E quella sozza imagine di froda
translation: And that filthy image of fraud

text: sen venne, e arrivò la testa e ’l busto,
translation: came forward, and landed its head and its bust,

text: ma ’n su la riva non trasse la coda.
translation: but onto the bank it did not draw its tail.

text: La faccia sua era faccia d’uom giusto,
translation: Its face was the face of a just man,

text: tanto benigna avea di fuor la pelle,
translation: so benign did it have the skin outside,

text: e d’un serpente tutto l’altro fusto;
translation: and of a serpent all the rest of the trunk;

text: due branche avea pilose insin l’ascelle;
translation: two paws it had, hairy up to the armpits;

text: lo dosso e ’l petto e ambedue le coste
translation: the back and the chest and both the sides

text: dipinti avea di nodi e di rotelle.
translation: it had painted with knots and with little circles.

text: Con più color, sommesse e sovraposte
translation: With more colors, in ground and in embroidery,

text: non fer mai drappi Tartari né Turchi,
translation: Tartars or Turks never made cloths,

text: né fuor tai tele per Aragne imposte.
translation: nor were such webs laid on the loom by Arachne.

text: Come talvolta stanno a riva i burchi,
translation: As sometimes the barges stand on the shore,

text: che parte sono in acqua e parte in terra,
translation: which are partly in water and partly on land,

text: e come là tra li Tedeschi lurchi
translation: and as there among the gluttonous Germans

text: lo bivero s’assetta a far sua guerra,
translation: the beaver settles itself to make its war,

text: così la fiera pessima si stava
translation: so the worst beast was staying

text: su l’orlo ch’è di pietra e ’l sabbion serra.
translation: on the rim which is of stone and encloses the sand.

text: Nel vano tutta sua coda guizzava,
translation: In the void all its tail was quivering,

text: torcendo in sù la venenosa forca
translation: twisting upward the venomous fork

text: ch’a guisa di scorpion la punta armava.
translation: which in the manner of a scorpion armed the tip.

text: Lo duca disse: "Or convien che si torca
translation: The leader said: "Now it is fitting that should bend

text: la nostra via un poco insino a quella
translation: our way a little as far as that

text: bestia malvagia che colà si corca".
translation: wicked beast which lies down there".

text: Però scendemmo a la destra mammella,
translation: Therefore we descended on the right-hand side,

text: e diece passi femmo in su lo stremo,
translation: and ten steps we made upon the edge,

text: per ben cessar la rena e la fiammella.
translation: so as to avoid well the sand and the flames.

text: E quando noi a lei venuti semo,
translation: And when we have come to it,

text: poco più oltre veggio in su la rena
translation: a little further on I see upon the sand

text: gente seder propinqua al loco scemo.
translation: people sitting close to the empty place.

text: Quivi ’l maestro "Acciò che tutta piena
translation: Here the master: "So that full

text: esperïenza d’esto giron porti",
translation: experience of this ring you may carry away",

text: mi disse, "va, e vedi la lor mena.
translation: said to me, "go, and see their condition.

text: Li tuoi ragionamenti sian là corti;
translation: Let your speeches there be short;

text: mentre che torni, parlerò con questa,
translation: until you return, I will speak with this one,

text: che ne conceda i suoi omeri forti".
translation: that she may grant us her strong shoulders".

text: Così ancor su per la strema testa
translation: So further along the extreme head

text: di quel settimo cerchio tutto solo
translation: of that seventh circle all alone

text: andai, dove sedea la gente mesta.
translation: I went, where the sad people were sitting.

text: Per li occhi fora scoppiava lor duolo;
translation: Through their eyes out burst their pain;

text: di qua, di là soccorrien con le mani
translation: here, there they helped themselves with their hands

text: quando a’ vapori, e quando al caldo suolo:
translation: now against the vapors, and now against the hot soil:

text: non altrimenti fan di state i cani
translation: not otherwise do dogs in summer

text: or col ceffo or col piè, quando son morsi
translation: now with the muzzle now with the paw, when they are bitten

text: o da pulci o da mosche o da tafani.
translation: either by fleas or by flies or by gadflies.

text: Poi che nel viso a certi li occhi porsi,
translation: After I set my eyes on the face of some,

text: ne’ quali ’l doloroso foco casca,
translation: on whom the sorrowful fire falls,

text: non ne conobbi alcun; ma io m’accorsi
translation: I did not know any of them; but I perceived

text: che dal collo a ciascun pendea una tasca
translation: that from the neck of each hung a pouch

text: ch’avea certo colore e certo segno,
translation: which had a certain color and a certain sign,

text: e quindi par che ’l loro occhio si pasca.
translation: and on that it seems that their eye feeds.

text: E com’io riguardando tra lor vegno,
translation: And as I come among them looking,

text: in una borsa gialla vidi azzurro
translation: on a yellow purse I saw azure

text: che d’un leone avea faccia e contegno.
translation: which had the face and bearing of a lion.

text: Poi, procedendo di mio sguardo il curro,
translation: Then, proceeding with the course of my gaze,

text: vidine un’altra come sangue rossa,
translation: I saw another as red as blood,

text: mostrando un’oca bianca più che burro.
translation: showing a goose whiter than butter.

text: E un che d’una scrofa azzurra e grossa
translation: And one who with a sow azure and big

text: segnato avea lo suo sacchetto bianco,
translation: had marked his little white sack,

text: mi disse: "Che fai tu in questa fossa?
translation: said to me: "What are you doing in this ditch?

text: Or te ne va; e perché se’ vivo anco,
translation: Now go away; and since you are still alive,

text: sappi che ’l mio vicin Vitalïano
translation: know that my neighbor Vitaliano

text: sederà qui dal mio sinistro fianco.
translation: will sit here by my left flank.

text: Con questi Fiorentin son padoano:
translation: With these Florentines I am a Paduan:

text: spesse fïate mi ’ntronan li orecchi
translation: many times they thunder in my ears

text: gridando: "Vegna ’l cavalier sovrano,
translation: shouting: 'Let the sovereign knight come,

text: che recherà la tasca con tre becchi!"".
translation: who will bring the pouch with three goats!'".

text: Qui distorse la bocca e di fuor trasse
translation: Here he twisted his mouth and out he stuck

text: la lingua, come bue che ’l naso lecchi.
translation: his tongue, like an ox that licks its nose.

text: E io, temendo no ’l più star crucciasse
translation: And I, fearing lest my staying longer anger

text: lui che di poco star m’avea ’mmonito,
translation: him who had warned me to stay little,

text: torna’ mi in dietro da l’anime lasse.
translation: turned back from the weary souls.

text: Trova’ il duca mio ch’era salito
translation: I found my leader, who had climbed

text: già su la groppa del fiero animale,
translation: already onto the rump of the fierce animal,

text: e disse a me: "Or sie forte e ardito.
translation: and he said to me: "Now be strong and bold.

text: Omai si scende per sì fatte scale;
translation: From now on one descends by such stairs;

text: monta dinanzi, ch’i’ voglio esser mezzo,
translation: mount in front, for I want to be in the middle,

text: sì che la coda non possa far male".
translation: so that the tail cannot do harm".

text: Qual è colui che sì presso ha ’l riprezzo
translation: As is one who has so near the shivering

text: de la quartana, c’ ha già l’unghie smorte,
translation: of the quartan fever, that he has already his nails pale,

text: e triema tutto pur guardando ’l rezzo,
translation: and trembles all over just looking at the shade,

text: tal divenn’io a le parole porte;
translation: such I became at the words offered;

text: ma vergogna mi fé le sue minacce,
translation: but shame made its threats to me,

text: che innanzi a buon segnor fa servo forte.
translation: which before a good lord makes a servant strong.

text: I’ m’assettai in su quelle spallacce;
translation: I settled myself upon those huge shoulders;

text: sì volli dir, ma la voce non venne
translation: I wanted to say, but the voice did not come

text: com’io credetti: ’Fa che tu m’abbracce’.
translation: as I believed: 'See that you embrace me'.

text: Ma esso, ch’altra volta mi sovvenne
translation: But he, who another time helped me

text: ad altro forse, tosto ch’i’ montai
translation: in another peril, as soon as I mounted

text: con le braccia m’avvinse e mi sostenne;
translation: with his arms clasped me and held me up;

text: e disse: "Gerïon, moviti omai:
translation: and he said: "Geryon, move now:

text: le rote larghe, e lo scender sia poco;
translation: the wheels wide, and let the descending be slow;

text: pensa la nova soma che tu hai".
translation: think of the new burden that you have".

text: Come la navicella esce di loco
translation: As the little boat goes out from its place

text: in dietro in dietro, sì quindi si tolse;
translation: backward, backward, so from there it drew away;

text: e poi ch’al tutto si sentì a gioco,
translation: and when it felt itself entirely free,

text: là ’v’era ’l petto, la coda rivolse,
translation: there where its chest had been, it turned its tail,

text: e quella tesa, come anguilla, mosse,
translation: and that one stretched, like an eel, it moved,

text: e con le branche l’aere a sé raccolse.
translation: and with its paws it gathered the air to itself.

text: Maggior paura non credo che fosse
translation: Greater fear I do not believe there was

text: quando Fetonte abbandonò li freni,
translation: when Phaethon abandoned the reins,

text: per che ’l ciel, come pare ancor, si cosse;
translation: whereby the sky, as still appears, was scorched;

text: né quando Icaro misero le reni
translation: nor when wretched Icarus his loins

text: sentì spennar per la scaldata cera,
translation: felt unfeathering because of the heated wax,

text: gridando il padre a lui "Mala via tieni!",
translation: his father crying to him 'You hold a bad way!',

text: che fu la mia, quando vidi ch’i’ era
translation: than was mine, when I saw that I was

text: ne l’aere d’ogne parte, e vidi spenta
translation: in the air on every side, and saw quenched

text: ogne veduta fuor che de la fera.
translation: every sight except of the beast.

text: Ella sen va notando lenta lenta;
translation: She goes away swimming slowly, slowly;

text: rota e discende, ma non me n’accorgo
translation: she wheels and descends, but I do not perceive it

text: se non che al viso e di sotto mi venta.
translation: except that on my face and from below the wind blows on me.

text: Io sentia già da la man destra il gorgo
translation: I heard already on the right hand the whirlpool

text: far sotto noi un orribile scroscio,
translation: make beneath us a horrible roar,

text: per che con li occhi ’n giù la testa sporgo.
translation: wherefore with my eyes downward I stretch out my head.

text: Allor fu’ io più timido a lo stoscio,
translation: Then I was more fearful of the dismounting,

text: però ch’i’ vidi fuochi e senti’ pianti;
translation: because I saw fires and heard laments;

text: ond’io tremando tutto mi raccoscio.
translation: whereupon I, trembling, all cling with my thighs.

text: E vidi poi, ché nol vedea davanti,
translation: And I saw then, for I had not seen it before,

text: lo scendere e ’l girar per li gran mali
translation: the descending and the circling through the great evils

text: che s’appressavan da diversi canti.
translation: which drew near from different sides.

text: Come ’l falcon ch’è stato assai su l’ali,
translation: As the falcon who has been long on the wing,

text: che sanza veder logoro o uccello
translation: who without seeing lure or bird

text: fa dire al falconiere "Omè, tu cali!",
translation: makes the falconer say 'Alas, you come down!',

text: discende lasso onde si move isnello,
translation: descends weary where it moves off swiftly,

text: per cento rote, e da lunge si pone
translation: through a hundred wheels, and far away alights

text: dal suo maestro, disdegnoso e fello;
translation: from its master, disdainful and sullen;

text: così ne puose al fondo Gerïone
translation: so Geryon set us at the bottom

text: al piè al piè de la stagliata rocca,
translation: at the very foot of the sheer-cut rock,

text: e, discarcate le nostre persone,
translation: and, having unloaded our persons,

text: si dileguò come da corda cocca.
translation: vanished like a notch from a bowstring.

text: Luogo è in inferno detto Malebolge,
translation: There is a place in hell called Malebolge,

text: tutto di pietra di color ferrigno,
translation: all of stone of iron color,

text: come la cerchia che dintorno il volge.
translation: like the circle that turns around it.

text: Nel dritto mezzo del campo maligno
translation: In the very middle of the malign field

text: vaneggia un pozzo assai largo e profondo,
translation: yawns a well quite wide and deep,

text: di cui suo loco dicerò l’ordigno.
translation: of which in its place I will tell the structure.

text: Quel cinghio che rimane adunque è tondo
translation: That belt which remains then is round

text: tra ’l pozzo e ’l piè de l’alta ripa dura,
translation: between the well and the foot of the high hard bank,

text: e ha distinto in dieci valli il fondo.
translation: and has its bottom divided into ten valleys.

text: Quale, dove per guardia de le mura
translation: As, where for guard of the walls

text: più e più fossi cingon li castelli,
translation: more and more moats gird the castles,

text: la parte dove son rende figura,
translation: the part where they are presents a figure,

text: tale imagine quivi facean quelli;
translation: such an image there those made;

text: e come a tai fortezze da’ lor sogli
translation: and as at such fortresses from their thresholds

text: a la ripa di fuor son ponticelli,
translation: to the outer bank there are little bridges,

text: così da imo de la roccia scogli
translation: so from the base of the cliff crags

text: movien che ricidien li argini e ’ fossi
translation: moved which cut across the banks and the ditches

text: infino al pozzo che i tronca e raccogli.
translation: as far as the well which truncates and gathers them.

text: In questo luogo, de la schiena scossi
translation: In this place, shaken off from the back

text: di Gerïon, trovammoci; e ’l poeta
translation: of Geryon, we found ourselves; and the poet

text: tenne a sinistra, e io dietro mi mossi.
translation: held to the left, and I moved behind.

text: A la man destra vidi nova pieta,
translation: On the right hand I saw new anguish,

text: novo tormento e novi frustatori,
translation: new torment and new scourgers,

text: di che la prima bolgia era repleta.
translation: with which the first pouch was replete.

text: Nel fondo erano ignudi i peccatori;
translation: At the bottom the sinners were naked;

text: dal mezzo in qua ci venien verso ’l volto,
translation: from the middle on this side they came toward our face,

text: di là con noi, ma con passi maggiori,
translation: beyond, with us, but with greater steps,

text: come i Roman per l’essercito molto,
translation: as the Romans because of the great army,

text: l’anno del giubileo, su per lo ponte
translation: in the year of the jubilee, over the bridge

text: hanno a passar la gente modo colto,
translation: have taken a way to make the people pass,

text: che da l’un lato tutti hanno la fronte
translation: so that on one side all have their forehead

text: verso ’l castello e vanno a Santo Pietro,
translation: toward the castle and go to Saint Peter,

text: da l’altra sponda vanno verso ’l monte.
translation: on the other side they go toward the mount.

text: Di qua, di là, su per lo sasso tetro
translation: Here, there, along the gloomy rock

text: vidi demon cornuti con gran ferze,
translation: I saw horned demons with great whips,

text: che li battien crudelmente di retro.
translation: who beat them cruelly from behind.

text: Ahi come facean lor levar le berze
translation: Ah how they made them lift their heels

text: a le prime percosse! già nessuno
translation: at the first blows! already none

text: le seconde aspettava né le terze.
translation: waited for the second nor the third.

text: Mentr’io andava, li occhi miei in uno
translation: While I was going, my eyes on one

text: furo scontrati; e io sì tosto dissi:
translation: were met; and I at once said:

text: "Già di veder costui non son digiuno".
translation: "Already of seeing this one I am not fasting".

text: Per ch’ïo a figurarlo i piedi affissi;
translation: Wherefore I stopped my feet to make him out;

text: e ’l dolce duca meco si ristette,

translation: which is always such as it was before;

text: ma per la vista che s’avvalorava
translation: but through my sight which was growing strong

text: in me guardando, una sola parvenza,
translation: in me as I looked, one single appearance,

text: mutandom’ io, a me si travagliava.
translation: as I changed, was transforming itself for me.

text: Ne la profonda e chiara sussistenza
translation: In the profound and clear subsistence

text: de l’alto lume parvermi tre giri
translation: of the high light there appeared to me three circles

text: di tre colori e d’una contenenza;
translation: of three colors and of one dimension;

text: e l’un da l’altro come iri da iri
translation: and one by the other as rainbow by rainbow

text: parea reflesso, e ’l terzo parea foco
translation: seemed reflected, and the third seemed fire

text: che quinci e quindi igualmente si spiri.
translation: which from this one and that one equally is breathed.

text: Oh quanto è corto il dire e come fioco
translation: Oh how short is speech and how faint

text: al mio concetto! e questo, a quel ch’i’ vidi,
translation: for my concept! and this, compared to what I saw,

text: è tanto, che non basta a dicer ’poco’.
translation: is such, that it is not enough to say 'little'.

text: O luce etterna che sola in te sidi,
translation: O eternal light that alone abide in yourself,

text: sola t’intendi, e da te intelletta
translation: alone understand yourself, and by yourself understood

text: e intendente te ami e arridi!
translation: and understanding love and smile on yourself!

text: Quella circulazion che sì concetta
translation: That circling which, so conceived,

text: pareva in te come lume reflesso,
translation: appeared in you as reflected light,

text: da li occhi miei alquanto circunspetta,
translation: by my eyes somewhat looked around,

text: dentro da sé, del suo colore stesso,
translation: within itself, of its own same color,

text: mi parve pinta de la nostra effige:
translation: seemed to me painted with our image:

text: per che ’l mio viso in lei tutto era messo.
translation: so that my sight was wholly set upon it.

text: Qual è ’l geomètra che tutto s’affige
translation: As is the geometer who wholly applies himself

text: per misurar lo cerchio, e non ritrova,
translation: to measure the circle, and does not find,

text: pensando, quel principio ond’ elli indige,
translation: by thinking, that principle which he needs,

text: tal era io a quella vista nova:
translation: such was I at that new sight:

text: veder voleva come si convenne
translation: I wanted to see how there fitted

text: l’imago al cerchio e come vi s’indova;
translation: the image to the circle and how it finds its place there;

text: ma non eran da ciò le proprie penne:
translation: but my own wings were not for this:

text: se non che la mia mente fu percossa
translation: except that my mind was struck

text: da un fulgore in che sua voglia venne.
translation: by a flash in which its wish came.

text: A l’alta fantasia qui mancò possa;
translation: To the high fantasy here power failed;

text: ma già volgeva il mio disio e ’l velle,
translation: but already was turning my desire and my will,

text: sì come rota ch’igualmente è mossa,
translation: like a wheel that is evenly moved,

text: l’amor che move il sole e l’altre stelle.
translation: the love that moves the sun and the other stars.
